explication: StarNet is a local-first desktop harness for creating bounded AI agents, arranging them as capability-scoped teams in a live station, and running real work through models and tools. The user-facing workflow spans agent setup, task intake and routing, execution, and review of file-based deliverables, with persistent transcripts, memory, spend, and run history. The README also documents channels, Night Shift, recipes and schedules, Task Briefs, voice, and MCP connectors. The graph reflects documented boundaries and sampled routing code; several runtime subsystems are represented by their enclosing directories because their source was not sampled.
